variable-state.title: One binding, a new value
variable-state.caption: A mutable row starts at 5. The statement row += 1 replaces the stored value with 6; it does not create two grains.

cell-coordinates.caption: A cell at column 3 and row 2 maps to drawing position x=12, y=8 when each cell is 4 drawing pixels wide in the low-DPI prototype.

ownership-borrows.title: Move ownership, or lend access
ownership-borrows.caption: A by-value move transfers a non-Copy value. Shared references lend read access; a mutable reference lends exclusive mutable access while used.

frame-tick-timeline.title: Drawing frames are not simulation ticks
frame-tick-timeline.caption: At a steady 60 FPS, frames arrive roughly every 16.67 milliseconds. At 20 TPS, simulation updates are due every 50 milliseconds; scheduling uses elapsed time, not frame count.
frame-tick-timeline.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

row-major-index.title: A two-dimensional grid in one vector
row-major-index.caption: For a four-column grid, row-major indexing assigns index = row × 4 + column. The highlighted cell at column 2, row 1 therefore has index 6.

negative-chunks.title: Negative positions still belong to a chunk
negative-chunks.caption: With chunk width 64, world x=-1 belongs to chunk -1 at local x=63. Euclidean division gives local coordinates from 0 through 63.

active-region.title: Storage chunks do not define the simulation boundary
active-region.caption: The active rectangle is the visible view plus a 16-cell margin on each side. Overlapping chunks can extend farther; update only their intersection with the active rectangle.
active-region.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

heat-and-exposure.title: Sky exposure and air contact are different questions
heat-and-exposure.caption: A roof blocks direct rain into a room. A sheltered wall can still touch local air and exchange heat. Local air contact must not imply exposure to the sky.
heat-and-exposure.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

four-phase-schedule.title: Four phases select separated chunk sets
four-phase-schedule.caption: Parity labels define four chunk sets. Only one label is dispatched in a phase. This illustrates scheduling; the actual rule footprint must still prove that reads and writes cannot conflict.
four-phase-schedule.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

support-anchor.title: A group needs support outside itself
support-anchor.caption: Adjacent rigid cells form one connected group. Their internal contacts are not external support. A grounded column can anchor the group, while an identical floating row falls.
support-anchor.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

random-ticks-calendar.title: Calendar advance and sampled work stay explicit
random-ticks-calendar.caption: An executed tick advances step_tick once. Its integer multiplier advances world_tick by M. Slow-process picks scale with M up to a cap; the fallback is approximate.
random-ticks-calendar.verification: Rendered locally from the restricted SVG shapes/text using installed Pillow; PNG visually inspected. Display this PNG to preserve the inspected pixels.

save-generation.title: Commit the pointer after the snapshot is complete
save-generation.caption: Write a coherent new generation of region files first. Only after its files are complete does the committed manifest select that generation. A crash before commitment leaves the old generation selected.

pixel-units.title: One cell occupies 2 × 2 art pixels
pixel-units.caption: A simulation cell occupies two by two art pixels. Each art pixel expands to a two by two block of physical pixels, producing a four by four physical-pixel cell.

release-artifacts.title: A desktop release is more than a source archive
release-artifacts.caption: Optimized native executables, required assets and licence notices become platform-specific packages. Each package needs an actual launch and save/load smoke test.

shoreline-mass.title: A drawn ripple cannot move shoreline material
shoreline-mass.caption: Rendered waves change colour only. Mechanical erosion needs a separate simulation rule that moves sand and respects the approved water-volume policy.

lake-bowl.title: A lake is held by occupied cells, not a painted shore
lake-bowl.caption: For centre64, half-width12 and level10, the teaching bowl floor is level minus (half-width minus distance). The rim at x52 and76 is stone at altitude10; the centre floor is altitude−2.

save-header-bytes.title: Fourteen bytes with an explicit layout
save-header-bytes.caption: The worked header begins with ASCII RSTY, then a two-byte little-endian version1, then an eight-byte little-endian seed42. Offsets0..4,4..6 and6..14 are distinct fields.

worker-epoch.title: A result must still belong to the current world
worker-epoch.caption: A worker owns its requested cell buffer. Its reply carries a world epoch and chunk identity. The main thread compares the epoch before installing the result; stale replies are discarded.

undo-state-match.title: Undo restores only cells still matching the painted state
undo-state-match.caption: The action records before and after. If the live cell still matches the painted after state, restore before. If wetness changed, full-state matching skips it instead of erasing that later change.
